description: An operations director must authorize an overnight validation campaign on Press 6 and finalize the setup, maintenance, and solvent-control plan before production begins, with input from maintenance and environmental health and safety.

shared_context.S1: Press 6 is available for a customer validation campaign producing 1,200 polymer housings during the overnight shift.
shared_context.S2: The standard validation setup uses a 50-piece trial before the campaign is released to production.
shared_context.S3: Marisol makes the final decision on whether the campaign proceeds and what controls are included in the operating plan.
shared_context.S4: Company procedure requires the operations director to conduct a pre-shift check-in with maintenance and environmental health and safety before releasing a validation campaign.

PF1.text: Theo's inspection found the Press 6 platen alignment is 0.7 millimeters out of tolerance, and the alignment service must be completed before the press runs; the service takes exactly 4 hours. He recorded the measurement in his maintenance notebook, but the work order is still awaiting entry in the maintenance system.

PF2.text: Priya's preliminary reading near Press 6 was 85 parts per million of the solvent used in the new release agent. The EHS limit is 50 parts per million, so the campaign requires local exhaust ventilation and continuous VOC monitoring until readings are at or below 50 parts per million; she is waiting for the laboratory confirmation before updating the area permit.

acceptance_conditions: The overnight validation campaign must not yet be authorized until the maintenance and EHS conditions are cleared.
Press 6 must have exactly 4 hours of maintenance outage before operation.
Platen alignment service must be required before the campaign.
Continuous VOC monitoring must be required during the campaign.
The operating plan must use a maximum VOC threshold of exactly 50 parts per million.
The validation trial must contain exactly 50 pieces.
A platen-alignment service commitment must be recorded.
The VOC finding must be cited as justification.

content_checks.C7: any(c['type'] in ('maintenance', 'pre_shift_check_in', 'work_order_entry') and 'alignment service' in c['detail'] and ('4-hour' in c['detail'] or '4 hours' in c['detail']) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The measured 0.7-millimeter platen error changes the pre-campaign plan from routine setup to exactly 4 hours of alignment service and adds the required service commitment.
The 85-parts-per-million solvent reading changes the operating controls to continuous VOC monitoring with an exact 50-parts-per-million limit and supplies the finding that must be cited.
